metadata.orrery:spec:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure finance-composition from .claude/orrery/plan.json. Evidence paths are relative to the repo root. title: "Shared finance rules: lib/finance and its backend mirror" subtitle: Page hooks call pure lib/finance modules; metricRules.ts and metric_rules.py hold the same matchers, kept in step by hand direction: down layout: { spacing: 0.6 }
legend: dotted: same rules kept in step by hand (no traffic)
story: [h-health, f-rules, b-rules, b-analytics]
groups: consumers: type: zone label: Page hooks and views evidence: frontend/src/pages libfin: type: zone label: frontend/src/lib/finance evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/metricRules.ts be-rules: type: zone label: backend core evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/metric_rules.py
nodes: # Page hooks, in the order their arrows enter lib/finance. h-income: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useIncomeAnalysis, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/income-analysis/useIncomeAnalysis.ts:23" } # Reads Age of Money, Days of Buffering, the transfer split and the health inputs from the backend # (GET /api/dashboard-metrics/pulse and /health); demo mode answers them with the browser calculators. h-dash: icon: tabler:app-window label: useDashboardMetrics note: demo mode runs the browser calculators in: consumers evidence: - "frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardMetrics.ts:22" - "frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardMetrics.ts:37" - "frontend/src/lib/demo/demoDashboardMetrics.ts:47" h-tax: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useTaxPlanning, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/tax-planning/useTaxPlanning.ts:27" } h-nw: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useNetWorth, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/net-worth/useNetWorth.ts:5-12" } h-health: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: Health score analysis, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/components/analytics/health/healthScoreAnalysis.ts:10-11" } h-goals: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useGoalsState, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/goals/useGoalsState.ts:7" } h-spend: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useSpendingAnalysis, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/spending-analysis/useSpendingAnalysis.ts:30" } # One node for two hooks that call the same module. h-returns: icon: tabler:app-window label: Returns, investments note: two hooks in: consumers evidence: - "frontend/src/pages/returns-analysis/useReturnsAnalysis.ts:18" - "frontend/src/pages/investment-analytics/useInvestmentAnalytics.ts:15"
# lib/finance modules. f-dash: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: dashboardMetrics, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/dashboardMetrics.ts } f-flows: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: investmentFlows, in: libfin, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/investmentFlows.ts:1" } f-taxhist: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: taxHistory, in: libfin, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/taxHistory.ts:5" } f-tax: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: taxPlanning, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/taxPlanning.ts } f-nw: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: netWorth, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/netWorth.ts } f-avg: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: monthlyAverage, in: libfin, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/monthlyAverage.ts:41-86" } f-rules: { icon: tabler:scale, label: metricRules.ts, in: libfin, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/metricRules.ts:26-88" } f-spend: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: spending, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/spending.ts } f-income: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: incomeMetrics, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/incomeMetrics.ts } f-returns: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: investmentReturns, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/investmentReturns.ts }
# Backend twin and its consumers: the Dashboard metrics ports of the browser calculators, and the analytics engine. b-dash: icon: tabler:gauge label: Dashboard metrics note: pulse and health reads in: be-rules align: b-rules evidence: - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/dashboard_metrics.py:150#dashboard_pulse" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/dashboard_metrics.py:171#dashboard_health" b-rules: { icon: tabler:scale, label: metric_rules.py, in: be-rules, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/metric_rules.py:66-284" } b-analytics: icon: tabler:chart-bar label: Analytics engine in: be-rules evidence: - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/summaries.py:17" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/fy_summaries.py:15" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/classification.py:13" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/base.py:23"
edges: # All call edges are inferred from imports and call sites. - { from: h-dash, to: f-dash, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardMetrics.ts:37#computeMonthlyChanges" } # HTTP, not a call: the hook asks the backend for the row-level figures it used to compute from /api/transactions/all. - from: h-dash to: be-rules label: "GET pulse, health" evidence: - "frontend/src/hooks/api/useDashboardMetricsApi.ts:15#dashboardPulseOptions" - "frontend/src/hooks/api/useDashboardMetricsApi.ts:23#dashboardHealthOptions" - "frontend/src/services/api/dashboardMetrics.ts:163#getPulse" - "frontend/src/services/api/dashboardMetrics.ts:168#getHealth" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/dashboard_metrics.py:28#get_dashboard_pulse" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/dashboard_metrics.py:47#get_dashboard_health" - { from: h-tax, to: f-taxhist, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/tax-planning/useTaxPlanning.ts:23" } - { from: h-tax, to: f-tax, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/tax-planning/useTaxPlanning.ts:27#computeAnnualTaxPlanning" } - { from: h-nw, to: f-nw, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/net-worth/useNetWorth.ts:12" } - { from: h-nw, to: f-avg, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/net-worth/useNetWorth.ts:5#averageMonthlySavings" } - { from: h-goals, to: f-avg, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/goals/useGoalsState.ts:7#averageMonthlySavings" } - { from: h-health, to: f-avg, label: month spine, evidence: "frontend/src/components/analytics/health/healthScoreAnalysis.ts:11#completeMonthSpine" } - { from: h-health, to: f-rules, label: essentials, evidence: "frontend/src/components/analytics/health/healthScoreAnalysis.ts:10#isEssentialExpense" } - { from: h-spend, to: f-spend, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/spending-analysis/useSpendingAnalysis.ts:30#computeBudgetRuleMetrics" } - { from: f-spend, to: f-avg, label: month spine, evidence: ["frontend/src/lib/finance/spending.ts:5#completeMonthSpine", "frontend/src/lib/finance/spending.ts:34#completeMonthSpine"] } - { from: h-income, to: f-income, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/income-analysis/useIncomeAnalysis.ts:23#computeIncomeMetrics" } - { from: h-returns, to: f-returns, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/returns-analysis/useReturnsAnalysis.ts:18#investmentReturnRules" } - from: h-returns to: f-flows label: calls evidence: - "frontend/src/pages/returns-analysis/useReturnsAnalysis.ts:17#investmentAccountTest" - "frontend/src/pages/investment-analytics/useInvestmentAnalytics.ts:14#investmentFlows" # lib/finance modules that build on the shared matchers. - { from: f-flows, to: f-rules, label: phrasePattern, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/investmentFlows.ts:1#phrasePattern" } - { from: f-taxhist, to: f-rules, label: salary vs bonus, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/taxHistory.ts:5#classifyEmploymentIncome" } # Hand-kept mirror: no import, no call, no arrowhead (metricRules.ts:60 isEssentialExpense, metric_rules.py:139 is_essential_expense). - from: f-rules to: b-rules label: mirrors line: dotted arrow: none evidence: - "frontend/src/lib/finance/metricRules.ts:60#isEssentialExpense" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/metric_rules.py:139#is_essential_expense" # Written from b-rules with the arrow flipped, like the analytics edge below: the Dashboard metrics ports call the matchers. - from: b-rules to: b-dash arrow: start label: classify evidence: - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/dashboard_metrics.py:41#essential_keywords" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/dashboard_metrics_pulse.py:19#is_investment_account" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/dashboard_metrics_health.py:22#is_essential_expense" # Written from b-rules with the arrow flipped, so Analytics engine sits after metric_rules.py along the flow. - from: b-rules to: b-analytics arrow: start label: classify evidence: - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/summaries.py:17#is_essential_expense" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/fy_summaries.py:15#is_tax_paid"

svg.title: Shared finance rules: lib/finance and its backend mirror
svg.desc: Shared finance rules: lib/finance and its backend mirror. 21 components in 3 groups. Connections: useDashboardMetrics to dashboardMetrics (calls); useDashboardMetrics to backend core (GET pulse, health); useTaxPlanning to taxHistory (calls); useTaxPlanning to taxPlanning (calls); useNetWorth to netWorth (calls); useNetWorth to monthlyAverage (calls); useGoalsState to monthlyAverage (calls); Health score analysis to monthlyAverage (month spine); Health score analysis to metricRules.ts (essentials); useSpendingAnalysis to spending (calls); spending to monthlyAverage (month spine); useIncomeAnalysis to incomeMetrics (calls); Returns, investments to investmentReturns (calls); Returns, investments to investmentFlows (calls); investmentFlows to metricRules.ts (phrasePattern); taxHistory to metricRules.ts (salary vs bonus); metricRules.ts to metric_rules.py (mirrors); metric_rules.py to Dashboard metrics (classify); metric_rules.py to Analytics engine (classify).

text.tspan: SHARED FINANCE RULES: LIB/FINANCE AND ITS BACKEND MIRROR
Page hooks call pure lib/finance modules; metricRules.ts and metric_rules.py hold the same matchers, kept in step by hand
SAME RULES KEPT IN STEP BY HAND (NO TRAFFIC)
